stem.text: The structure of butenedioic acid is shown.

stem.alt: Skeletal formula of butenedioic acid, HOOC–CH=CH–COOH, labelled butenedioic acid

stem.text: When an excess of $\text{NaOH(aq)}$ is added to butenedioic acid, which organic product is formed?

A.alt: Skeletal formula: O- carboxylate at each end of a CH=CH unit

B.alt: Skeletal formula: saturated C4 chain with one OH group, COOH at each end

C.alt: Skeletal formula: C4 chain with two OH groups, COOH at each end

D.alt: Skeletal formula: O- carboxylate at one end and COOH at the other, joined by a CH=CH unit
